dod_intent_evidence: Passes the intent gate: Air Force SBIR Phase II 2023, $1,249,955, 'Protecting Critical Infrastructure with Near Real-Time Geospatial Intelligence', whose abstract names 'The Air Force Civil Engineering Center (AFCEC) and civil engineering squadrons'; HigherGov shows a most recent award of Oct 7, 2025. Fails the evidence-sufficiency gate instead.
score_evidence: The pack header claims ~983 own-language words, but the same single homepage is crawled three times (bostongeospatial.com, www.bostongeospatial.com, and a mailto: variant) — unique own-language is roughly 400 words

The SBIR abstract is truncated mid-sentence at 'The Air Force Civil Engineering Center (AFCEC) and civil engineering squadrons' — the operational detail that would let deployment topics surface is not in the pack

No jobs data, and the product description reaches only marketing-level granularity ('RISK SCREENING', 'NEAR REAL-TIME ALERTS', 'MONITORING'), so absence of DDIL/ATO/operator language cannot be scored as blindness rather than as brevity
what_they_do: Two-person geospatial intelligence firm using satellite radar interferometry and optical change detection to screen, monitor and alert critical-infrastructure owners to geohazards, flooding and fire risk.
